title: Cryptonomicon
author: Neal Stephenson
summary: Two timelines follow a codebreaker in the Second World War and his grandson, a computer expert, in the dot-com era. Both are tied to a hidden fortune and a plan to build a secure data haven.
readIf: you enjoy very long, nerdy novels full of cryptography, history and digressions, with dry humour.
skipIf: you want a tight plot, since it wanders widely and takes its time.

pairings.reason: The same author's wilder and shorter cyberpunk satire, with plenty of sharp humour.
Another Stephenson epic that stops for long, lively explanations of how things work.
A very different, satirical take on the Second World War, with absurd humour.
